GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3 Wide 4th 3 Lengths 800m 3 Wide 6th 3 Lengths home turn 3 Wide 5th Middle Of Track Straight tired final 100m # wide/very honest
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover for majority. Hampered and carried wider approaching 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Checked 1200m 8th 10 Lengths 800m 8th 7 Lengths home turn 6th Middle Of Track ran on final 200m # chk/very good run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and was slow to begin. After travelling a short distance was checked from heels. Upon straightening, laid in and became awkward near heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m 2nd .5 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden 2nd Middle Of Track Straight Kept Going Ok # on pace/honest run
Jumped quick to sit 2nd 4wide gone 300m # weak/no finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout. Laid in under pressure in the early  part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: pre race Vet examination (passed fit), Slow Out 2 Lengths , Settled Worse than midfield Two Wide 7 Lengths 700m, worked to Middle Of Track and in Clear Straightening Up , Just one paced in Straight and only battled, Vet revealed no abnormalities, cross over noseband first time, nasal strip first time, Tongue Tie first time, winkers off first time # one paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary and was passed suitable to race. Began awkwardly. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok landed box seat 3l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off all clear, running on took over passing 200m, drew 1 length clear 100m and kept going strong to the line # just too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 300m laid in and bumped a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Rolled fwd before raced 5th Two Wide (3L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed to quicken @ 500m. Raced tight Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & worked to challenge leader @ 150m. Fought on in two-horse battle in last 150m until shaded late. # Had his chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1100m was steadied when placed in restricted room to the inside of another runner which shifted in before being corrected. When attempting to improve into a narrow run between another runner and a runner which was laying out, became very awkwardly placed on the heels of another runner near the 400m when that horse was taken out slightly by another runner. Passing the 200m had to be corrected after shifting in and making contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced keenly Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 550m. Pushed out Six Wide @ 500m & pushed along Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 250m & chased soundly in last 200m. # Good for further.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early stages. Raced greenly in the home straight, shifting ground on several occasions.
